appDescription: A business-car logbook that writes itself: it records the dashboard odometer at every ignition cycle, classifies commutes and client visits from the places the owner registered, and produces the National Tax Service vehicle logbook.

function.name: LOG_TRIP_PURPOSE
function.description: Record the purpose of the trip that just ended (within the last 30 minutes) in the business-car logbook, if it has no purpose yet (changing a recorded purpose is done on the screen with a reason). Use when the user says what the last drive was for, e.g. '방금 운행 업무로 기록해 줘', '거래처 미팅이었어', '출근한 거야', '개인 용무였어', '방금 건 김기현이 탄 거야'. COMMUTE = going to or from work, BUSINESS = client visits, meetings, deliveries and other work, PERSONAL = anything private. FAMILY = family drive, said before or during a drive ('가족 운행 켜 줘', '이번엔 가족이랑 가는 거야'): the app reads no location for the drive under way, or for the next one when parked, and records only its distance as personal; it cannot be used for a drive that already ended.

purpose.description: Purpose of the trip: COMMUTE (출퇴근), BUSINESS (일반 업무), PERSONAL (비업무) or FAMILY (가족 운행: the drive under way or the next one, no location read, recorded as personal).

memo.description: Short note for the remarks column, such as the client or the errand (e.g. '일양상사 미팅'). Omit if the user gave none.

user_name.description: Name of the registered person who used the car on this trip, only if the user said it.

function.name: GET_LOGBOOK_STATUS
function.description: Tell the user the logbook totals: number of trips, distance, business-use ratio, how many trips still need a purpose and the estimated tax-deductible vehicle expense effect. Use for questions such as '이번 달 업무 비율 얼마야', '운행기록부 상태 알려줘', '올해 업무용으로 몇 퍼센트 탔어', '목적 안 정한 운행 있어?'.

period.description: THIS_MONTH for the current month (default), THIS_YEAR for the current business year.

function.name: SEND_LOGBOOK
function.description: Create the National Tax Service format logbook workbook for a period, save it in the car and send it to the address the owner registered (company server or e-mail relay). Use for requests such as '지난달 운행기록부 보내줘', '이번 달 운행일지 만들어줘', '올해 운행기록부 회사로 보내'.

period.description: Which period to write: THIS_MONTH (default), LAST_MONTH or the current BUSINESS_YEAR.
